description: Ministry of Higher Education & HIghways - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1603/35 of 28.05.2009 which specifies Faculties & the Departments of the University of Sri Jayawardenapura,, adding Dept. of Philosophy and Psychology, Dept. of Sports Science
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order issued under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on statutory amendments rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content fits the definition of Type 5 as it involves legal amendments and regulatory modifications to existing legislation.
